campaign_brief: Introduce Patagonia's Men's Nano Puff Jacket, style 84212, to an English-speaking US audience planning everyday outings and outdoor trips. Highlight verified packability and practical features. Use a direct, useful tone and one invitation to explore the product details. Avoid prices, discounts, urgency and unsupported environmental claims.
raw_response:
### CHANNEL COPY

Patagonia’s Men’s Nano Puff® Jacket, style 84212, is built for days when you want warmth without a lot of bulk.

Its lightweight, highly compressible design makes it easy to bring along for everyday outings and outdoor trips. A key detail is the internal zippered chest pocket, which doubles as a stuffsack, so the jacket can pack down into itself when you want to save space. Other practical features include a center-front zipper with an interior storm flap and chin zipper garage, two zippered handwarmer pockets, and a drawcord-adjustable drop-tail hem.

The jacket is also listed as warm, windproof, and water-resistant. It uses a shell with a DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS.

Take a closer look at the product details to see how the features fit your day.

### REVIEWER NOTES

**Sourced facts used in the copy**
- Men’s Nano Puff® Jacket, style 84212
- Lightweight and highly compressible
- Internal zippered chest pocket doubles as a stuffsack
- Center-front zipper with interior storm flap and chin zipper garage
- Two zippered handwarmer pockets
- Drawcord-adjustable drop-tail hem
- Warm, windproof, and water-resistant
- Shell has a DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS

**Supporting source paths / URLs**
- `knowledge_base/primary/product_facts.md`
- https://www.patagonia.com/product/mens-nano-puff-insulated-jacket/84212.html

**Editorial interpretations**
- Framing the jacket as suitable for “everyday outings and outdoor trips” is positioning based on the campaign brief, not a product claim.
- “Built for days when you want warmth without a lot of bulk” is a concise editorial restatement of the verified warmth and packability facts.

**Limitations / uncertainties**
- The product page does not state a publication or update date.
- Water-resistant is not waterproof.
- No claims are made about care, repair, returns, trade-in, pricing, discounts, urgency, environmental impact, or unverified performance results.

## Retrieval query
Channel: linkedin
Campaign brief:
Introduce Patagonia's Men's Nano Puff Jacket, style 84212, to an English-speaking US audience planning everyday outings and outdoor trips. Highlight verified packability and practical features. Use a direct, useful tone and one invitation to explore the product details. Avoid prices, discounts, urgency and unsupported environmental claims.
Revision feedback:
## Current channel copy

Built for everyday outings and outdoor trips, Patagonia’s Men’s Nano Puff® Jacket, style 84212, is made to be easy to pack and practical to wear.

It’s listed as warm, windproof, and water-resistant, with a lightweight, highly compressible build. The internal zippered chest pocket doubles as a stuffsack, so it can stash down small when plans change. Other details include a center-front zipper with an interior storm flap and chin zipper garage, two zippered handwarmer pockets, and a drawcord-adjustable drop-tail hem.

The shell is 100% recycled polyester ripstop with a durable water repellent finish made without intentionally added PFAS, and the insulation is 60-g PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco.

Explore the product details if you want a closer look at the features and care notes.

## Human feedback

Revise this LinkedIn draft to 130–160 words.

Keep packability and the internal zippered chest pocket that doubles as a stuffsack as the main focus. Retain only verified product details supported by the retrieved primary context. Use one neutral CTA. Remove the invitation to explore care notes; do not introduce care, repair, returns or trade-in claims.

Rewrite Reviewer notes to list only facts actually stated in the revised copy and only source paths/URLs supporting those facts. Do not list unused regular-fit, quilting, insulation-composition, P.U.R.E. or care details. Separate editorial interpretations from sourced facts and retain applicable limitations.

Do not add prices, discounts, urgency, waterproofing or environmental-impact claims.
End of retrieval query.

- For the cited Men's Nano Puff® Jacket, style 84212, the product page lists: machine wash warm; do not bleach; tumble dry low; do not iron. [Product page](https://www.patagonia.com/product/mens-nano-puff-insulated-jacket/84212.html)
- Patagonia’s US Returns & Exchanges page directs customers to Product Care & Repair, Patagonia-owned stores and a repair start page. The linked Product Repair page explicitly says to clean the product before sending it in and that an item will be returned to the customer to wash if it is not clean. [Returns & Exchanges](https://www.patagonia.com/returns.html) [Product Repair](https://www.patagonia.com/start-repair/)
- Patagonia’s Worn Wear page describes used gear as washed, inspected and backed by the Ironclad Guarantee. It says items are inspected, authenticated, graded for condition and repaired when needed; it also offers trade-in for credit and DIY care and repair guides. [Worn Wear](https://www.patagonia.com/worn-wear/)
- Patagonia frames care, repair, buying used and trading in as ways to keep gear in play. These are general company and Worn Wear services, not a promise that every style, damage type or trade-in is eligible.
included_chunks.applicable_limitations: - The accessed pages do not promise that every 84212 repair will be possible, free or eligible for trade-in. Availability, eligibility and process details can change; verify before publication.
